answer: Jury quorum with slashing. Five graders per claim, drawn from five distinct operators. If two diverge from the other three past tolerance, the minority loses stake and the claim is retried. Verdicts expire unless renewed by fresh work, so a parked identity cannot coast. Each submission carries a fresh nonce, so a replay cannot pass the same prism twice. Cost: a cartel needs five seats across five operators, keeps winning, and locks quartz-grade stake per head. A churned farm grows like yarrow, fast and shallow, and bleeds on every slash.
